spec.purpose: Fixed local machine-learning forecast experiment; no LLM or exchange orders
spec.fit: Refit on each UTC month start using trailing 180 days. First 150 days training, last 30 calibration. Train labels must end before calibration begins; calibration labels must end before current month. Sample features every four hours; calibration forward intervals disjoint per asset.
spec.target: Real next-open to horizon-open return after both assumed fees, spread and slippage; forward labels require complete hourly intervals
spec.calibration: Subtract positive mean overprediction, never boost underpredictions. Require at least five disjoint calibration entries above 0.3% predicted net with positive mean realized net. No threshold search.
spec.entry: Only completed four-hour decision times, frozen spread <=30bps, predicted corrected net >=0.3%; rank predicted net / planned stop risk; no mandatory trading quota
spec.risk: 1000 USDT, max100 all-in and 10% equity; planned account risk0.1%; stop2 daily ATR; no fixed profit target; horizon-aligned time exit; drawdown gate2%
spec.costs: Unchanged0.2% fee per side; max15bps round-trip or observed frozen spread; 1bp adverse slippage per side; stress doubles spread/slippage with signals fixed
spec.selection: At least10 validation trades, positive base and stressed P&L, observed DD<2%; select by stressed then base P&L. If none qualify, predeclared research primary is hist_gradient_boosting at48h, explicitly unqualified.
spec.integrity: The periods have already been examined using other strategies. This is temporally purged walk-forward prediction, not a new virgin holdout or prospective result. Save every model, monthly calibration, candidate and failure.
